verdict.rationale: BVNK documents a Transfers v.3 API for wallet-to-wallet currency conversion, with conversion as a property of a transfer, digest-based quote acceptance and mandatory idempotency. It also supports fiat and crypto wallets managed via Portal or API, and markets moving value between fiat balances and stablecoins. Only the API path is clearly documented. Missing for 10: dashboard/Portal-based internal transfer or rebalancing flow, explicit treasury rebalancing guidance beyond conversion, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can move value between fiat and stablecoin balances on the platform — internal transfers and rebalancing through the API or dashboard, documented end to end

citations.quote: The Transfers v.3 API replaces the legacy Quote API for wallet-to-wallet currency conversion.
currency conversion is now a property of a transfer. Migrating to v.3 provides a single-field status model, digest-based quote acceptance, mandatory idempotency
On BVNK, you can create and manage both crypto and fiat wallets through the Portal or API.
Use your fiat balance to send stablecoins, or fund in stablecoins and pay out in fiat.
